title: aromatic chinese eggplant bao
description: romantic chinese dish featuring fresh thyme with pungent, gooey eggplant
instructions: slice the eggplant into 1/2-inch thick rounds
heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute
add the sliced eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is tender and lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes
meanwhile, combine the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch in a small bowl and stir to combine
add the hoisin sauce mixture to the wok or skillet and stir to combine
bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes
to assemble the bao, spread a thin layer of the eggplant mixture onto a piece of dough, then top with a few slices of scallion and a sprig of thyme
fold the dough over the filling to form a bun and place it on a baking sheet
repeat with the remaining dough and filling
brush the tops of the bao with a little bit of sesame oil and bake in a preheated oven at 4009 for 15-20 minutes, or until the bao are golden brown
meanwhile, combine the flour and water in a small bowl and stir to combine
dough is ready to use once it's smooth and elastic
